review.notes: Checked against full judgment, no changes. Batch order over 7 connected petitions (AVIK POLYMERS, KAMDHENU PLASTIC, SHRI BALAJI PLASTIC, SHRIRAM ENTERPRISES [this case], MANSI PLASTICS, SANJAY ENTERPRISES, R.V ENTERPRISES); the SCN (23.07.2024) and order (27.01.2025) dates are stated generically for 'the present petitions' as a group, not singled out for one lead petitioner, so unlike the JBN Impex batch (case DLHC010184962026) these are genuinely common facts, not another petitioner's. contested=false is correct and is a good example of rule 5 working as intended: this judgment applies its own precedent (Ambika Traders) and the Commercial Steel Limited SC case on writ maintainability generally, but never itself notes the Bombay HC's contrary Milroc/Rite Water line (seen in other cases in this batch) or any pending SC case on this specific point -- so despite the real conflict existing elsewhere, this judgment's own text doesn't flag it, and per rule 5 we don't import outside knowledge. consolidated_scn/defect_rejected and disposed/not-remanded (relegated to statutory appeal) both correct.
